notices.title: 05.26.26 City Council agenda
notices.agenda_text:
AMERICAN FORK CITY COUNCIL
MAY 26, 2026
		CITY COUNCIL AGENDA




*Notice of Electronic Meeting*
One or more City Council members may be physically absent from this meeting but may participate electronically.

The American Fork City Council will hold a public hearing in conjunction with the regular session on Tuesday, May 26, 2026, in the American Fork City Hall, 31 North Church Street, commencing at 7:00 p.m. The agenda shall be as follows:

PUBLIC HEARING
1.	Receive public comments on amendments to the fiscal year ending June 30, 2026, city budget.
2.	Receive public comment on the 620 South Annexation consisting of 6.816 acres and located at approximately 700 West 620 South.
REGULAR SESSION
1.	Pledge of Allegiance; Invocation by Council Member Carroll; roll call. 
2.	Twenty-minute public comment period - limited to two minutes per person. 
3.	City Administrator's Report 
4.	Council Reports 
5.	Mayor's Report 
COMMON CONSENT AGENDA
 (Common Consent is that class of Council action that requires no further discussion or which is routine in nature.  All items on the Common Consent Agenda are adopted by a single motion unless removed from the Common Consent Agenda.)
1.	Approval of the April 28, 2026, work session minutes.
2.	Approval of the May 5, 2026, work session minutes.
3.	Approval of the May 12, 2026, city council minutes.
4.	Approval of a Class A Beer license for Mid City Enterprises Inc, DBA Mid City Lounge, located at 494 North 950 West Suite A.
5.	Ratification of city payments (May 6, 2026, to May 19, 2026) and approval of purchase requests over $50,000. 
ACTION ITEMS
1.	Review and action on a resolution approving amendments to the fiscal year ending June 30, 2026, city budgets.
2.	Review and action on an ordinance approving the disbursement of FY2025-2026 PARC Tax funds.
3.	Review and action on acceptance of the withdrawal of application for the Chipman/Stake Center Annexation.
4.	Review and action for an approval of a reimbursement agreement for Climb Ventures LLC for the Climb Concrete project.
5.	Review and action on a resolution approving fireworks restrictions for 2026.
6.	Review and action on a resolution providing for the disposition of lost or mislaid property or seized property.
7.	Review and action on an ordinance approving amendments to Chapter 5 of the American Fork Municipal Code regarding final appeals to the City Council on certain business license decisions.
8.	Adjournment. 

Dated this 21st day of May 2026.

Terilyn Lurker
City Recorder

-	In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, the City of American Fork will make reasonable accommodations to participate in the meeting. Requests for assistance can be made by contacting the City Recorder at 801-763-3000 at least 48 hours in advance of the meeting.
-	The order of agenda items may be changed to accommodate the needs of the City Council, staff, and the public.

notices.title: 05.26.26 Public Hearing - 620 South Annexation
notices.agenda_text:
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING OF THE CITY'S INTENT TO ANNEX REAL PROPERTY LOCATED AT APPROXIMATELY 700 WEST 620 SOUTH, AMERICAN FORK.

On April 14, 2026, the City Council of American Fork, Utah, adopted Resolution No. 2026-04-15R, indicating its intent to annex the following described real property:

	620 SOUTH ANNEXATION
	 (700 WEST 620 SOUTH)

BEGINNING AT A POINT LOCATED SOUTH 89°52'20' WEST ALONG SECTION LINE 1672.42 FEET FROM THE SOUTHEAST CORNER OF SECTION 22, TOWNSHIP 5 SOUTH, RANGE 1 EAST, SALT LAKE BASE AND MERIDIAN;

THENCE SOUTH 28.58 FEET;  THENCE WEST 498.06 FEET;  THENCE ALONG THE AF10 ANNEXATION BOUNDARY THE FOLLOWING THREE COURSES AND DISTANCES:  1) NORTH 0°01'04' WEST 27.47 FEET,  2) NORTH 89°52'20' EAST 25.67 FEET, AND 3) NORTH 0°00'06' WEST 577.22 FEET;  THENCE ALONG THE DIXIE FENN ANNEXATION PLAT 'A' THE FOLLOWING TWO COURSES AND DISTANCES: 1) NORTH 22.33 FEET,  AND 2) SOUTH 89°59'29' EAST 472.41 FEET;  THENCE SOUTH 598.42 FEET TO THE POINT OF BEGINNING.


Notice is hereby given that the American Fork City Council will hold a public hearing in conjunction with the regular session on May 26, 2026, at 7:00 p.m. in the American Fork City Hall, 31 North Church Street, for the purpose of receiving public comment regarding the proposed annexation.

The City Council may annex the above described real property unless, at or before the public hearing, written protests to the annexation are filed by the owners of real property that is located within the area proposed for annexation in accordance with applicable provisions of UCA 10-2-812.
This annexation is be pursued without a petition in accordance with UCA 10-2-812.

Copies of a map showing the location of the annexation area are available for review by the public at the City Recorders Office, 51 East Main Street, during normal business hours.

Dated this 27 day of April 2026       	
 
Terilyn Lurker, City Recorder

notices.title: 05.12.26 Public Hearing - Chipman/Stake Center Annexation - CANCELLED
notices.agenda_text:
Public Hearing Notice - Chipman/Stake Center Annexation
Notice is hereby given that a petition for annexation was filed with American Fork City. The petition, which was accepted by the city council on October 22, 2024, covers approximately 24 acres consisting of property located at approximately 515 South 100 West.  The city recorder certified the petition, and the legislative body provided notice according to Utah Code 10-2-406. A 30-day period was allowed to give property owners and affected entities the opportunity to submit written protests. A public hearing was previously held on February 25, 2025.
A public hearing will be held on Tuesday, May 12, at 7 p.m. at the American Fork City Hall (31 N. Church Street) to allow the public to comment on the Chipman/Stake Center Annexation. After the public hearing, American Fork City may choose to deny or grant the petition and annex the area described in the petition. 
The complete annexation petition is available for inspection and copying at the American Fork City Recorder's office (51 E. Main Street, American Fork) or by emailing tlurker@americanfork.gov
Dated this 30th day of April 2026.
/s/ Terilyn Lurker, City Recorder
